digest.component_or_area: codebase maintenance / Tier-1 and Tier-2 code quality remediation
propositions: environment inheritance bug in _read_local_tickets and _read_local_ticket_full allows ambient REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off to suppress live sync pull when no_sync=False, requiring explicit env construction and key stripping on live path

_HAVE_ASTGREP capability flag is dead-copied in test_conformance.py and test_coverage_reconstruction.py but never used in skipif directives (actual ast-grep test monkeypatches _ASTGREP_CANDIDATES instead)
test_validation_depth.py lacks a non-review category test to prove input-contract validation is category-agnostic

BatchRunner.run signature inconsistency: ProductionBatchRunner accepts optional agent_runner but base BatchRunner, DefaultBatchRunner, and CodeReviewBatchRunner do not, breaking mypy override compatibility
Tier-2 dead symbols (_RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, _PRIORITY_JIRA_TO_LOCAL, _TYPE_JIRA_TO_LOCAL, _SCRIPTS_DIR, _REFUTE_ELIGIBLE_KINDS, and 8 test fixture constants) are verified unused and must be removed
after remediation mypy and linting must pass cleanly with regression tests for AI-1 environment bug and AI-3b non-review validation test both green
